method: In a large bowl, combine besan + dahi . whisk till no lumps

Punjabi Kadhi without Pakodas 

Ingredients
55 grams besan ( 1/2 cup ) 
2 cups dahi, room tempreture is best!!!
1/2 tsp red chilli powder +1/2 turmeric powder + 1 tsp coriander powder
6 cups water
1 tbsp oil
1/2 tsp methi seeds + 1/2 tsp cumin seeds
pinch of hing
2 onions, finely sliced
2 green chillies, either sliced lenghtwise or chopped
1 tbsp minced ginger + garlic each
salt to taste

coriander to garnish 

tadka
1 tbsp ghee
1/4 tsp cumin
pinch of ajwain
2-3 dried red chillies
1/2 tsp red chilli powder

Method 

in a large bowl, combine besan + dahi . whisk till no lumps 
add in red chilli, turmeric and coriander powder to this and whisk until you achieve a smooth, lump-free consistency.
pour in 6 cups of water  and thoroughly mix until well combined. Set aside
Heat mustard oil, make sure you are using a big kadhai / pan since it is a ;arge batch of liquid  Once the oil is hot, methi seeds and cumin seeds, allowing them to splutter. Then, add hing
iIntroduce sliced onions and chopped green chilies into the pan, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add chopped ginger and garlic, cooking for an additional minute until they begin to change color.
Pour the prepared besan-yogurt mixture into the pan. With the heat still on medium-high, stir continuously until the kadhi reaches a boil.
Once the kadhi boils, reduce the heat to low-medium and allow it to simmer for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add salt after the kadhi has been cooking for approximately 15 minutes. While the kadhi is simmering, proceed to make the pakora.
